name: BACH_0006_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (67%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Stain-degraded simulated frozen section is flagged unreliable [F6], and the conformal set cannot separate InSitu from Normal [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 67%, Normal 31%, Benign 2%, Invasive 0% | Favors InSitu; invasive risk 0% |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90% coverage) | Cannot separate InSitu from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 33% (flagged) / 78% OOD | Suspect stain-degraded frozen section |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match InSitu (all Normal, 85–88%) [F5] | Nearest neighbors are all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 4, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest pull (-1.84) against invasion [F2], but 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 4, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasion (+1.42) despite 0% invasive score [F3] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 6, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical stromal score (-0.59) pulling against invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Descriptive score near baseline (8/20 AI spot-check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random (diff +0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion diff +0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot-check).

## Could be wrong if
- Severe stain degradation (severity 3) on frozen section mimics InSitu in normal tissue (5/5 neighbors Normal).
- Infiltrating-stroma signal in regions 4, 8, 11 reflects focal invasion masked by degraded section quality (cells disabled).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 8, 2**: Highest heatmap risk (46%, 14%, 5%); inspect ducts for in situ atypia versus normal lobules.
2. **Regions 4, 8, 11**: Highest infiltrating-stroma scores; check stroma and review drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
3. **Regions 8, 2**: Near inferior/medial (98%) and superior (94%) margins; defer frozen margin call to permanents [F7].
